subject: science
prompt:
# Bigger, and Then What?

Proto's descendants are surviving well enough to get larger. More room, more material, more chemistry going on at once.

> **What goes wrong first when one cell gets much bigger?**

Make the call now. The rest of the lesson is the answer.

options.text: It runs out of atoms to build with.
options.feedback: The ocean is not short of raw material. The trouble starts inside.

options.text: Everything is happening in one shared space, and the jobs start interfering with each other.
It becomes too heavy and sinks.
options.feedback: Sinking is survivable. What happens inside is the real difficulty.

options.text: Nothing goes wrong - bigger is simply better.
options.feedback: Hold on to this one. It is exactly the assumption the next two lessons take apart.
